relationships.subject: 2-arachidonoylglycerol
relationships.evidence_quote: 2‐AG potently increased the expression of COX2, IL‐1β, IL‐6 and IL‐8 with a maximal effect at 10 μM

relationships.subject: 2-arachidonoylglycerol
relationships.evidence_quote: S1P3 protein levels were significantly increased by the endocannabinoid

relationships.subject: S1P3
relationships.evidence_quote: the selective knockdown of S1P3 impaired the 2‐AG‐induced increase of COX2, IL‐1β and IL‐6 transcription

relationships.subject: 2-arachidonoylglycerol
relationships.evidence_quote: 2‐AG augmented the release of pro‐inflammatory cytokines IL‐1β, IL‐6 and IL‐8 in endometriotic epithelial cells

key_findings: 2-AG, but not methanandamide, induces COX-2 and IL-1β/IL-6/IL-8 in endometriotic epithelial cells via S1P3 upregulation and signaling, independent of SK1/SK2.
